profile.headline: Software Engineer - at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Andres has 8+ years of experience developing software professionally, with an Engineer’s degree in Computer Systems, he is a versatile Senior Developer with a strong knowledge of Software Design & Architecture.

Andres has experience as Team Leader, coordinating teams both onshore & offshore to ensure timely delivery with great quality.

Vast experience with JavaScript and most famous frontend frameworks like Angular2+, React.js and Vue.js. Background in Java SE/EE and Node.js that complements his Engineering work, creating REST APIs and backend systems that allow him easily connect both worlds.

Key Aspects:

- 8+ years of experience developing web applications with JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
- Experience with a variety of javascript frameworks & libraries such as Angular2+, React.js, Vue.js, Redux.js, Bootstrap, lodash, jQuery, Node.js, Express.js, Mocha, Jasmine, Cypress, SASS, LESS, stylus.
- 4+ years of backend work with enterprise software such as Java EE and Spring Framework.
- Implementation of GraphQL using Apollo.
- Experience with build tools as Webpack and Gulp to implement browser performance best practices.
- Usage of databases as MySQL and MongoDB.
- Worked with agile methodologies Scrum and Kanban.
- Knowledge in Android and React Native.
- Web Accessibility implementation with the WAI-ARIA specification.
- Implementation of containers with Docker.
- Experience in continues integration (CI) and continues delivery (CD).

Tech stack JS: Angular2+, React.js, Node.js, Webpack, Redux, RxJs, Cypress, Karma, Jasmine, Mocha, Sinon, Protractor, Gulp, Grunt.

Tech stack Java: Spring Framework, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, JUnit, Maven.

AWS: API Gateway, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch, CloudFront, Cognito, DynamoDB.

Retired soccer player, video game lover, movie fan, curious researcher.
